# rcapsule

> Compile any R project, Quarto manuscript, `targets` pipeline, or Shiny
> app into lean Docker/Apptainer containers with cryptographic
> reproducibility verification.

`rcapsule` bridges the reproducibility gap between R package lockfiles
(`renv.lock`) and the underlying operating system, native libraries,
compiled scientific toolchains, cross-architecture builds, and output
verification required for durable open science and production
deployment.

- **Documentation website:** <https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/>
- **Source repository:** <https://github.com/MarcusHarrisUConn/rcapsule>

## Why `rcapsule`?

- **`renv` stops at the R library layer.** Projects still break across
  machines due to mismatched OS system libraries (`libgdal-dev`,
  `libxml2-dev`, `libharfbuzz-dev`), C++ compilers, `CmdStan`,
  `TMB`/`RTMB`, `JAGS`, `Rust`, `Python`/`reticulate`, `Quarto`,
  `LaTeX`/`TinyTeX`, or hidden `.Rprofile` traps.
- **Multi-target & cross-architecture portability.** Compile pinned,
  Posit PPM binary-accelerated multi-stage `Dockerfile`s (with
  `--platform=linux/amd64` / `linux/arm64` support), production
  multi-service `docker-compose.yml` stacks (Shiny + async worker +
  reverse proxy), and HPC-ready Apptainer `.def` recipes from a single
  project scan.
- **Cryptographic proof & peer-review bundles.** Hash inputs, scripts,
  container specs, seeds, environment digests, and outputs into a
  tamper-evident, optionally `HMAC-SHA256`-signed `capsule.json`, verify
  in an isolated sandbox (with ambient secret scrubbing) or Docker
  container, compare runs across machines with
  [`diff_capsules()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/diff_capsules.md),
  and export zip-slip-safe journal supplements via
  [`export_capsule_bundle()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/export_capsule_bundle.md).

## Core Capabilities

| Pillar | Key Functions | What It Does |
|:---|:---|:---|
| **1. Project & Toolchain Scanner** | [`scan_project()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/scan_project.md), [`sysreqs_db()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/sysreqs_db.md), [`resolve_sysreqs()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/resolve_sysreqs.md) | Parses R scripts (`library`, `pacman::p_load`, [`xfun::pkg_attach`](https://rdrr.io/pkg/xfun/man/pkg_attach.html), `box::use`, `::`), Quarto/Rmd chunks, `DESCRIPTION`, `renv.lock` (including non-CRAN remotes), `_targets.R`, `here::here()`, `.Rprofile` hazards, and host architecture to resolve OS `apt` libraries and toolchains (`C++`, `CmdStan`, `TMB`/`RTMB`, `JAGS`, `Rust`, `Java`, `Python`, `Quarto`, `LaTeX`). |
| **2. Multi-Target Container Compiler & Linter** | [`compile_dockerfile()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/compile_dockerfile.md), [`compile_compose()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/compile_compose.md), [`compile_apptainer()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/compile_apptainer.md), [`lint_container_spec()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/lint_container_spec.md) | Emits pinned, layer-cached multi-stage Dockerfiles (`platform`, Posit PPM binaries), hardened Shiny + worker + proxy Compose stacks, and HPC Apptainer `.def` recipes; statically audits specs for `:latest` tags, `curl\|sh`, root execution, `network_mode: host`, `docker.sock` mounts, and baked secrets. |
| **3. Cryptographic Provenance & Cross-Run Diffing** | [`create_capsule_manifest()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/create_capsule_manifest.md), [`read_capsule_manifest()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/read_capsule_manifest.md), [`write_capsule_manifest()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/write_capsule_manifest.md), [`sign_manifest()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/sign_manifest.md), [`verify_manifest_integrity()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/verify_manifest_integrity.md), [`diff_capsules()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/diff_capsules.md) | Generates canonical UTF-8 `capsule.json` (schema v1.0.0) with Git state, environment digest, RNG kind/seed, `SHA-256` hashes, and constant-time `HMAC-SHA256` verification; diffs runs across machines (`Laptop` vs. `HPC`). |
| **4. Isolated Auditor, Certificates & Bundler** | [`verify_capsule()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/verify_capsule.md), [`compare_artifacts()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/compare_artifacts.md), [`render_certificate()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/render_certificate.md), [`export_capsule_bundle()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/export_capsule_bundle.md), [`build_capsule()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/build_capsule.md) | Re-runs pipelines in an isolated local sandbox (scrubbing ambient host credentials and detecting extra artifacts) or Docker container, compares CSV/TSV/JSON/RDS outputs with exact and `atol`/`rtol` comparators, renders CSP-hardened HTML5/Markdown certificates, and packages journal-ready ZIP supplements. |

## Installation

``` r

# Install development version from GitHub
# remotes::install_github("MarcusHarrisUConn/rcapsule")
```

## Quick Start

``` r

library(rcapsule)

# 1. Scan, compile (pinned linux/amd64 + Posit PPM binaries), lint, sign, and verify
bundle <- build_capsule(
  path        = "path/to/project",
  targets     = c("dockerfile", "compose", "apptainer"),
  inputs      = "data/raw.csv",
  outputs     = c("results/summary.csv", "results/metrics.json"),
  seed        = 2026L,
  tolerances  = list(atol = 1e-4, rtol = 1e-4),
  key         = Sys.getenv("CAPSULE_SIGNING_KEY"),
  platform    = "linux/amd64",
  use_ppm     = TRUE,
  verify      = TRUE,
  certificate = TRUE
)

# 2. Compare manifests across runs or machines
diff_capsules("author_capsule.json", "reviewer_capsule.json")

# 3. Export a zip-slip-safe journal peer-review supplement bundle
export_capsule_bundle(
  path         = "path/to/project",
  output       = "journal_supplement.zip",
  manifest     = bundle$manifest,
  verification = bundle$verification,
  platform     = "linux/amd64"
)
```

## Vignettes & Guides

- [`vignette("getting-started", package = "rcapsule")`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/articles/getting-started.md):
  End-to-end reproducibility capsules, HMAC signing, tamper detection,
  and tolerance-aware verification.
- [`vignette("multi-target-containers", package = "rcapsule")`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/articles/multi-target-containers.md):
  Compiling Quarto manuscripts, production Shiny + async worker Compose
  stacks, and Bayesian HPC Apptainer recipes.
- [`vignette("journal-submission-workflow", package = "rcapsule")`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/articles/journal-submission-workflow.md):
  Signed peer-review capsules, cross-machine
  [`diff_capsules()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/diff_capsules.md),
  and
  [`export_capsule_bundle()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/export_capsule_bundle.md).
- [`vignette("troubleshooting-reproducibility", package = "rcapsule")`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/articles/troubleshooting-reproducibility.md):
  Monte Carlo `atol`/`rtol` tolerances, `.Rprofile` traps, `targets`
  pipelines, and Apple Silicon vs. `amd64` builds.
- See
  [ARCHITECTURE.md](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/ARCHITECTURE.md)
  and [SECURITY.md](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/SECURITY.md)
  for architecture and red-team security details.

# Package index

## End-to-End Orchestration & Supplement Export

High-level workflows for building complete reproducibility capsules and
exporting zip-slip-safe journal peer-review supplements.

- [`build_capsule()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/build_capsule.md)
  : Build a Complete Reproducibility Capsule for an R Project
- [`export_capsule_bundle()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/export_capsule_bundle.md)
  : Export a Journal-Ready Reproducibility Supplement Bundle

## Full-Stack Project & Toolchain Scanner

Static AST and project scanners resolving R packages, OS system
libraries, compiled scientific toolchains, .Rprofile hazards, and
architecture hints.

- [`scan_project()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/scan_project.md)
  : Scan an R Project for Dependencies, System Libraries, and Scientific
  Toolchains
- [`sysreqs_db()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/sysreqs_db.md)
  : Built-in OS System Dependency (sysreqs) Registry
- [`resolve_sysreqs()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/resolve_sysreqs.md)
  : Resolve OS System Dependencies for a Set of R Packages

## Multi-Target Container Compilers & Static Linter

Generate and audit pinned, layer-cached Dockerfiles, multi-service
docker-compose.yml stacks, and HPC-ready Apptainer recipes.

- [`compile_dockerfile()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/compile_dockerfile.md)
  : Compile a Layer-Cached Multi-Stage Dockerfile

- [`compile_compose()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/compile_compose.md)
  :

  Compile a Production Multi-Service `docker-compose.yml`

- [`compile_apptainer()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/compile_apptainer.md)
  : Compile an HPC-Ready Apptainer / Singularity Definition File

- [`lint_container_spec()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/lint_container_spec.md)
  : Lint a Container Specification for Reproducibility and Security
  Issues

## Cryptographic Provenance Manifests & Cross-Run Diffing

Create, serialize, sign, verify, and diff tamper-evident capsule.json
manifests with SHA-256 hashes and keyed HMAC-SHA256 signatures.

- [`create_capsule_manifest()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/create_capsule_manifest.md)
  :

  Create a Cryptographic Provenance Manifest (`capsule.json`)

- [`write_capsule_manifest()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/write_capsule_manifest.md)
  :

  Write a Capsule Manifest to `capsule.json`

- [`read_capsule_manifest()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/read_capsule_manifest.md)
  :

  Read a Capsule Manifest from `capsule.json`

- [`sign_manifest()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/sign_manifest.md)
  : Sign a Capsule Manifest with HMAC-SHA256

- [`verify_manifest_integrity()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/verify_manifest_integrity.md)
  : Verify Cryptographic Integrity and Signature of a Capsule Manifest

- [`diff_capsules()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/diff_capsules.md)
  : Diff Two Capsule Provenance Manifests Across Runs or Machines

## Reproducibility Verification & Certificates

Execute pipelines in isolated sandboxes or Docker containers, compare
outputs with exact and numeric-tolerance comparators, and render
publication-ready verification certificates.

- [`verify_capsule()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/verify_capsule.md)
  : Verify Computational Reproducibility Against a Capsule Manifest
- [`compare_artifacts()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/compare_artifacts.md)
  : Compare Two Output Artifacts with Exact SHA-256 and Numeric
  Tolerance
- [`render_certificate()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/render_certificate.md)
  : Render a Journal-Ready Reproducibility Verification Certificate

## Runtime Capability Checks

Detect local Docker daemon and Apptainer/Singularity CLI availability.

- [`docker_available()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/docker_available.md)
  : Check whether Docker daemon is available
- [`apptainer_available()`](https://marcusharrisphd.com/rcapsule/reference/apptainer_available.md)
  : Check whether Apptainer or Singularity CLI is available
